$comment: Seventy-four live authority mutants replace the retired hand-scanner set. Every id is bound to a named owning test whose exact TAP failure is required before a mutant can be PROVEN. The runner verifies a gate-owned scratch repository, copies it to a private ephemeral execution root, and rebinds five local pre-import hashes only in that disposable copy so semantic, bundle, renderer, extractor, and schema guard mutants reach their behavioural assertions. Every clean baseline requires the shipped hashes to be an exact no-op, then runs both the live-Firefox and unit-only lanes; every browser-verifier mutation runs live Firefox and requires an exact non-SKIP TAP receipt. Gate, production, and installed package roots remain read-only. Historical checkpoint dispositions remain in semantic-disposition.json.
